freeze_scope: task source, simulator configuration, condition definitions, seed protocol, success predicate, and evaluation protocol

validation_status_at_freeze.reason: User requested that all GPU work stop and the current task be frozen immediately. Earlier simulator artifacts were generated from older source fingerprints and are retained only as historical evidence.

instruction: Put the can into the basket.

can_sampling.arm_choice: uniform left/right using the native place_can_basket sampling order

occluder.implementation: RoboTwin procedural dynamic opaque create_box, boxtype=long

conditions.visible: The block starts at the revealed pose and is canonicalized to that same pose before policy handoff.
conditions.missing: The block starts at the occluding pose and receives no intervention.
conditions.oracle_reveal: The pre-intervention state is identical to missing; before the first policy observation only the block is teleported to the visible revealed pose and its linear/angular velocity is zeroed.
conditions.equal_handoff_settle: All three conditions receive exactly five scene steps before the first policy observation.

pairing.same_seed_requirement: can model/pose, basket model/pose, robot qpos/qvel, cameras, textures, randomization config, lighting, clutter, and all non-block actor state must match

visibility.detector: SAPIEN per-scene actor-ID segmentation in head_camera, left_camera, and right_camera
visibility.missing_requirement: can pixel count is exactly zero in every one of the three cameras
visibility.visible_and_oracle_requirement: can has at least 32 pixels in at least one of the three cameras
visibility.basket_requirement: basket has at least 32 pixels in head_camera
visibility.block_requirement: block has at least 32 pixels in at least one of the three cameras

success.predicate: The can center is within the basket metadata lateral bounds and vertical placement interval; the basket is upright; the can contacts the basket but not the table; the can-side gripper is open; and can/basket relative motion remains below the frozen thresholds for 25 consecutive physics steps.

episode_tracking.sample_timing: after every qpos action and requested observation
episode_tracking.can_visibility: tracked in all three policy cameras

expert_protocol.missing: grasp/lift/translate/release block, verify can visible, then can-to-basket
expert_protocol.oracle_reveal: environment oracle moves only the block before handoff, then direct can-to-basket

native_approximate_block_movement.evidence_boundary: approximate native long-block manipulation analogue, not an exact calibration of this occluder or reveal sequence

evaluation_protocol.rule: Run policy evaluation only on this frozen task. Never change geometry, sampling, conditions, camera, horizon, randomization, or success predicate in response to FastWAM results.

gpu_policy.launch_rule: Immediately before every GPU launch, require the selected GPU to have no foreign compute or non-Xorg graphics context; otherwise refuse to launch.
gpu_policy.render_isolation: Explicit SAPIEN PCI render device plus a bubblewrap device namespace exposing only the selected NVIDIA and matching DRI nodes.
